Privacy Policy

Reviews World is the official companion and quality-assurance app testing platform. We collect account details only to manage user profile status, testing tasks, notifications, and support interactions inside this app.

Information We Use

Name, email, mobile number, app testing activity logs, support chat history, and verification feedback documents submitted by users for admin quality check.

How It Is Used

Information is used for user authentication, validating app testing submissions, managing reward points, providing user support, and security purposes. We do not ask for or store credit cards, bank accounts, passwords, or transaction PINs.

Data Safety

Users should access only the official Reviews World interface and should never share login credentials, OTPs, or remote screen access with anyone claiming to represent Reviews World support.

Contact

For privacy or data safety concerns, contact reviewsworld01@gmail.com.
